name: Coocaa K3 Pro 90P3D Max
summary: Coocaa K3 Pro 90P3D Max ships with vendor content and preinstalled apps. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This Skyworth Coocaa K3 Pro runs the China-market Coocaa OS on Android 11. It ships with vendor content and preinstalled apps. The list has 23 apps in two groups and is the first China-market Coocaa list here. It shares nothing with Skyworth's Google TV sets.

The Coocaa home screen is never turned off, because the TV hangs on its logo and needs a factory reset if it is. TidyTV leaves it on. It turns the rest off from your phone with a backup first and deletes nothing. TidyTV turns these off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything.
keep: The Coocaa home screen, which the boot depends on
The TV app and local media
notes: Never turn off the Coocaa home screen. Doing so hung the TV on the logo and the remote stopped working, and only a factory reset fixed it.
This firmware hides Developer options. Debugging comes from a secret factory menu and switches off again at every restart.
Almost no app shows on the home grid, so the apps need adding by hand.

faq.q: What happens if the Coocaa home screen is turned off?
faq.a: The TV hangs on the Coocaa logo and the remote stops working, and only a factory reset fixes it. TidyTV keeps it on.

faq.q: Why does debugging switch itself off?
faq.a: This firmware turns it off at every restart. You switch it on again from the factory menu.

faq.q: Can I get everything back if I change my mind?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app TidyTV turned off back on in one tap.
